The '''Atron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atron]] located within the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />
